findings.excerpt: Baker's round extended his TEG 12 Trophy lead to 13.
Meller's lifted him off the bottom of the Wooden Spoon table.
Stuart Neumann now occupies last place instead.
He opened strongly through holes 3 to 5, gaining four shots against par net, including a par salvaged on the par-5 3rd.
Across holes 8 to 11 he dropped 12 shots and did not register a single net par.
The centrepiece was a quadruple bogey 8 at the 10th, one of the hardest holes on the course.
Holes 15 to 17 cost him eight more shots, headlined by a triple bogey at the 15th, the hardest hole at Boavista.

findings.excerpt: Williams's gross score was a personal best for Boavista, three shots inside his previous best of 105 and four better than his last visit, on his sixth trip to the course.
Five previous attempts had been worse.
He held par or better across the 4th, 5th and 6th, the pars including one on the tricky par-3 6th, among the harder holes on the course.
A double bogey ended the streak and pushed him back over par for the round.
A bogey followed at the par-5 8th, one of the easiest holes at Boavista.
By the end of that hole Neumann had sunk to the bottom of the Wooden Spoon standings, overtaking Henry Meller, with one shot separating the two men.
